c1.note: AWS's own author page, Amazon's Sept 17, 2026 article and Wood's LinkedIn profile all give his title as Chief AI & Technology Officer.

c3.note: The page's H1 reads 'chief AI and technology officer', but its URL slug and the title listed on LinkedIn use 'AWS CTO'; this is a weak, headline-wording point.

c6.note: His LinkedIn About section states this and the AWS blog bio says the same.

c8.note: TechCrunch quotes him: 'This is my final re:Invent keynote... I'm not leaving Amazon'.

c11.note: IT Brew's October CTO-shifts piece and Rezaei's LinkedIn (now at AWS) are consistent with this, but the excerpt does not show the quote.

c14.note: The Jan 30, 2026 article lists Vogels among those who stayed on the org chart, as Amazon's overall CTO.

c15.note: Vogels still holds the Amazon-wide CTO title per AWS's own page and the Jan 2026 org chart, and nothing shows The Information listing him; Wood's AWS role does not make that outdated.

c16.note: The AWS Executive Insights page labels him 'Dr. Werner Vogels, VP & CTO at Amazon.com'.

c17.note: The About Amazon article, dated Nov 25 2025, calls him 'Amazon's chief technology officer'; this is still his current title.

c18.note: The page says 'Published: November 25, 2025'; the date is older than 90 days and is only supporting detail.

c22.note: Amazon sources call Vogels 'Amazon CTO' and none uses the literal title 'AWS CTO' for him.

c23.note: He remains a public face of AWS tech, though he stopped giving the re:Invent keynote in 2025. The claim is vague and omits Matt Wood.

c24.note: Wikipedia describes him as 'American computer scientist and Amazon CTO'; this matches the other sources.

c25.note: The page was last edited 1 Nov 2026 and still calls him Amazon CTO; no departure is shown in the excerpts.

c26.note: Amazon's own Sept 2026 article names Matt Wood AWS Chief AI and Technology Officer, so an AWS-specific tech chief is reported.

c10.note: Vogels said he was not leaving Amazon and was only giving up the keynote. The saved pages and my search found no reporting that speculated about his retirement, and no reporting that he retired.

c12.note: Search results on the Sivasubramanian memo say Rezaei will start on Kiro and Quick. I did not find that wording in the saved IT Brew page.

c13.note: GeekWire reports he joined AWS as a distinguished engineer; his CTO title was at Microsoft Copilot. I could not see the LinkedIn headline in the saved page, so confidence is medium.

c1.note: Amazon's Sept 17, 2026 article, his AWS Insights author page and the AWS Newsroom all name Matt Wood as AWS Chief AI & Technology Officer. He rejoined in May 2026 in this newly created role.

c2.note: Amazon's article dated Sept 17, 2026 says that at the AWS Global Meeting, Wood laid out a vision for where AI is heading and gave a live demo.

c10.note: Sources show Vogels gave his final re:Invent keynote in Dec 2025 and said he was not retiring or leaving Amazon. No source found reports retirement speculation after that. The 'not ready to retire' headlines are from 2021, and Wikipedia doesn't mention it.

c24.note: Wikipedia calls him Amazon's CTO and VP, 'in charge of driving technology innovation within the company'. AWS Summit London (April 2026) lists him as VP & CTO, Amazon.com. No departure has been reported. This is Amazon's CTO title, not an AWS one.
